the level of technology transferred to Mexican workers in maquiladora firms is very low and that the Japanese maquiladoras transfer more technology than the American or Mexican maquildoras.

Japanese maquiladoras in Tijuana train more of their workers than do American and Mexican maquiladoras and provide a greater level of technology transfer through their training programs than do American and/or Mexican maquiladora firms.

the relationship between training and the technology transfer of Japanese, Mexican, and American maquiladoras in Tijuana.
the transfer of advanced technology through the training of maquiladora employees and the impact of such training on the development of Mexican human resources.
the relationship between training programs and technology transfer in the maquiladora industry.

there is no significant difference in the amount of training provided by American, Mexican or Japanese maquiladora companies, however, the Japanese maquiladoras provide a greater degree and more advanced technology transfer through training.
Japanese maquiladoras provide more technology transfer through training to Mexican employees than either Mexican or American maquiladoras.
